items.headline: Tesla, Alphabet lose hundreds of billions in value in post-earnings stock plunge
items.summary: Both Tesla and Alphabet signaled higher spending as they invest in artificial intelligence.

items.headline: Odds of Federal Reserve rate hike surge as oil prices rip higher
items.summary: Investors are increasingly readying for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates in September.

items.headline: Intel Faces Earnings Test After 28% July Drop Despite Strong Q2 Expectations
items.summary: Intel is expected to post stronger Q2 results, but semiconductor sentiment and valuation remain key investor concerns.

items.headline: Tesla short sellers mint $4 billion profit as shares nosedive
items.summary: Tesla shares plunged up to 15% after weak quarterly earnings, triggering about $4.1 billion in one-day gains for short sellers. Concerns over AI spending, high valuation, and soft auto margins weighed on sentiment, though retail investors continued buying and some analysts see the decline as a long-term opportunity.

items.headline: Brent crude crosses $100 after tankers reportedly struck off Saudi Arabia
items.summary: Oil prices rose after attacks on ships in the Red Sea, and U.S. President Donald Trump's threatened to bomb Iranian infrastructure.

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Plunge On Negative Reaction To Tesla, Alphabet Earnings, Surging Crude Oil
items.summary: After ending Wednesday's choppy session modestly lower, stocks showed a more substantial move to the downside during trading on Thursday. The major averages all moved notably lower, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq showing a particularly steep decline.

items.headline: Intel forecast crushes estimates as AI boom boosts chip demand; shares jump
Amazon and Microsoft pivot cloud gaming strategies to target different players
items.summary: Amazon is bringing Luna to the Prime Video streaming service, while Microsoft will test an ad-supported streaming of titles that people own.

items.headline: Cerebras stock gains on AMD partnership
items.summary: Cerebras and AMD agreed to work together, pairing their technology for AI systems.

items.headline: Backlog Mania: Stocks to Watch This Earnings Season
items.summary: Order backlogs are a central theme this earnings season, and AI and data center companies with increasing order backlogs are expected to continue to prosper. items.headline: Intel's stock jumps as chipmaker rides AI boom to fastest revenue growth in almost 15 years
items.summary: Intel rallied after the company reported blowout earnings and guidance.

items.headline: Oracle signs 10-year software contract with Pentagon worth up to $7 billion
items.summary: Oracle will supply on-premises software to the U.S. Department of Defense.

items.headline: Trump to slap 'sweeping' new tariffs on 60 trade partners as global duties expire
items.summary: The Trump administration has ramped its tariff actions back up since the president's trade  agenda suffered major legal setbacks earlier this year.

items.headline: DOJ withdraws subpoenas to NY Times reporters in Trump plane probe
items.summary: The subpoenas to New York Times reporters were issued by Manhattan U.S. Attorney Jay Clayton, whom Trump has nominated as director of national intelligence.

items.headline: OpenAI's Hugging Face hack triggers 'AI Kill Switch' bill in Congress
items.summary: OpenAI disclosed this week that some of its AI models went rogue and hacked into open-source developer platform Hugging Face.

items.headline: Southwest Airlines put Texas jet fuel on a boat to LA for the first time amid supply worries
items.summary: Southwest hired a ship this spring to send fuel from Houston to Los Angeles in case of supply shortages.

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield rises to highest since January 2025 as surging oil rekindles inflation fear
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields climbed on Wednesday, following oil prices higher, as traders also reacted to a slump in weekly claims for unemployment insurance.

items.headline: As the S&P 500 sells off, traders eye key 'risk pivot' level
items.summary: Options traders are seeking clues on whether more volatility may be ahead.

items.headline: US stocks today: Nasdaq plunges 2% as tech earnings spark AI spending worries
items.summary: Wall Street closed sharply lower with Nasdaq down over 2% as weak Big Tech earnings and rising AI spending concerns hit sentiment. Surging oil prices above $100, driven by Middle East tensions, reignited inflation fears and pushed bond yields higher, overshadowing gains in defense stocks like Lockheed Martin.

items.headline: IBM's Krishna tries to reassure investors that AI won't disrupt company's software unit
items.summary: IBM's CEO highlighted growing mainframe hardware capacity, and said software should "catch back up" within a year.

recs.market_summary: El mercado está experimentando una caída en los principales índices, con el S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cayendo debido a las preocupaciones sobre la inflación y las tasas de interés. Los tecnológicos están liderando la caída, con Tesla y Alphabet perdiendo valor después de sus informes de ganancias. El petróleo crudo también está subiendo, lo que está presionando a la economía.
